info.title: sipsorcery
info.description: SIPSorcery CLI: route and bridge live media streams between SIP, WebRTC and the major realtime fabrics (Cloudflare Realtime, LiveKit) and AI agents (OpenAI Realtime), built on the SIPSorcery library. A stream is the primitive; verbs attach edges to it. Human and agent friendly with JSON output and meaningful exit codes.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SIPSorcery CLI: route and bridge live media streams between SIP, WebRTC and the realtime fabrics.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: route
commands.description: Route a media stream from a --from source edge to one or more --to sink edges (a v0.1 stream graph).

options.name: --from
options.description: The source edge to pull a stream from: testpattern (a generated H264 pattern + PCMU music), whep:<url> (a live WebRTC stream), sip:<uri> (place a SIP call and forward its audio, e.g. sip:music@iptel.org), livekit:<room> (subscribe to a LiveKit room; needs --url/--api-key/--api-secret) or cloudflare:<sessionId> (pull a Cloudflare Realtime SFU session published by the cloudflare sink; needs --app-id/--token).

options.name: --to
options.description: A sink edge to push the stream to: a file path (VP8->IVF, H264/H265->Annex B), "play" (ffplay), "null" (discard), "-" (bitstream on stdout), whip:<url> (publish to a WebRTC endpoint), web[:port] (self-host a WHEP server + player page on localhost, default port 8080, to watch in a browser), livekit[:room] (publish into a LiveKit room; needs --url/--api-key/--api-secret) or cloudflare (publish to a Cloudflare Realtime SFU session; needs --app-id/--token). Repeat --to to fan out to several sinks at once.

options.name: --duration
options.description: Seconds to run for. The default 0 runs until the source ends (a live source hanging up) or ctrl-c; set a positive value to stop after a fixed time. [default: 0]

options.name: --fps
options.description: Frame rate for a generated source (testpattern) and for the --scope video. [default: 30]

options.name: --token
options.description: Bearer token for a transport edge: a whep stream key, the whip endpoint Authorization, or the Cloudflare SFU API token (else CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN).

options.name: --scope
options.description: For an audio source (sip:), add a generated "audio scope" video track that visualises the audio. [default: False]

options.name: --scope-mode
options.description: Scope visualisation: waves (a moving waveform) or spectrum (a scrolling frequency spectrum). [default: waves]

options.name: --scope-size
options.description: Scope video size WxH. [default: 640x360]

options.name: --ffmpeg-path
options.description: Directory containing the ffmpeg executable used for the --scope video. Defaults to ffmpeg on the PATH.

options.name: --username
options.description: Optional username for authenticating a sip: source call.

options.name: --password
options.description: Optional password for authenticating a sip: source call.

options.name: --audio-codec
options.description: Audio codec the sinks offer / a generated source produces: opus (default, the universal WebRTC codec) or pcmu/pcma for an endpoint that only accepts G.711. A G.711 sip: call is transcoded up to opus automatically, so opus needs no flag. [default: opus]

options.name: --no-open
options.description: For a web sink, do not automatically open a browser at the listen URL (it is also never opened with --json). [default: False]

options.name: --url
options.description: For a livekit edge: the LiveKit web socket URL (wss://...). Defaults to the LIVEKIT_WEBSOCKET_URL environment variable.

options.name: --api-key
options.description: For a livekit edge: the LiveKit API key. Defaults to the LIVEKIT_API_KEY environment variable.

options.name: --api-secret
options.description: For a livekit edge: the LiveKit API secret. Defaults to the LIVEKIT_API_SECRET environment variable.

options.name: --app-id
options.description: For a cloudflare sink: the Cloudflare Realtime SFU app ID (its API token comes from --token). Defaults to the CLOUDFLARE_APPID environment variable (token: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN).

options.name: --timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for the operation to complete. [default: 30]

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result to stdout as a single JSON object instead of human readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Write diagnostic logs, including protocol traces, to stderr. [default: False]

commands.name: bridge
commands.description: Connect two duplex endpoints both ways (full duplex), e.g. talk to a voice agent: bridge web agent.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port for the web endpoint's local page. [default: 8080]

options.name: --no-open
options.description: With a web endpoint, do not automatically open its page in a browser (it is also never opened with --json). [default: False]

options.name: --voice
options.description: Voice for the agent. agent: an Azure neural TTS voice (default en-US-GuyNeural; must be neural for visemes). openai: an OpenAI Realtime voice e.g. marin, alloy, verse (default marin).

options.name: --persona
options.description: System prompt giving the agent its character (default: the Max Headroom persona).

options.name: --greeting
options.description: What the agent says when the far side connects (default: a Max Headroom greeting).

options.name: --llm
options.description: OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint for the agent (Ollama/LM Studio/OpenAI/OpenRouter). Without it the agent just repeats what it heard.

options.name: --llm-model
options.description: Model for --llm (default llama3.2).

options.name: --api-key
options.description: API key: the OpenAI key for the openai endpoint (else OPENAI_API_KEY), or the bearer key for a hosted agent --llm gateway (OpenRouter/OpenAI). Local servers ignore it.

options.name: --azure-key
options.description: Azure Speech resource key for the agent (else AZURE_SPEECH_KEY).

options.name: --azure-region
options.description: Azure Speech resource region for the agent, e.g. westeurope (else AZURE_SPEECH_REGION).

options.name: --avatar
options.description: Give the agent a lip-synced video face (the Max Headroom avatar): a video track to the web peer, or a video call to a sip: peer. [default: False]

options.name: --user
options.description: Username to authenticate a sip: endpoint's call (if the destination challenges).

options.name: --password
options.description: Password for the sip: endpoint's --user.

options.name: --duration
options.description: Seconds to run for. 0 (default) runs until a participant leaves or ctrl-c. [default: 0]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for the operation to complete. [default: 30]

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the result to stdout as a single JSON object instead of human readable text. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Write diagnostic logs, including protocol traces, to stderr. [default: False]

arguments.name: A
arguments.description: The first endpoint: web, agent, openai or sip:<uri>.

arguments.name: B
arguments.description: The second endpoint: web, agent, openai or sip:<uri>.
